Typedef Documentation

typedef struct acds_handoff_entry acds_handoff_entry_t

Background thread for periodic cleanup. Wakes up every 5 minutes to:

  • Remove old rate limit events from the database
  • Clean up expired sessions

            void acds_server_shutdown (acds_server_t * server)
          

          

            Shutdown discovery server. Closes listen socket, stops accepting
            connections, waits for handler threads to exit, closes database, and
            frees resources.
          

          

          
Parameters

          

            server Server structure to clean up

167                                                  {
168   ASCII_OTEL_SCOPE(DISCOVERY_SHUTDOWN);
169   if (!server) {
170     return;
171   }
172
173   // Signal shutdown to worker threads
174   atomic_store_bool(&server->shutdown, true);
175
176   // Stop and destroy worker thread pool (cleanup thread, etc.)
177   if (server->worker_pool) {
178     thread_pool_destroy(server->worker_pool);
179     server->worker_pool = NULL;
180     log_debug("Worker thread pool stopped");
181   }
182
183   if (server->handoff_mutex_initialized) {
184     mutex_lock(&server->handoff_mutex);
185     while (server->handoffs) {
186       acds_handoff_entry_t *entry = server->handoffs;
187       server->handoffs = entry->next;
188       SAFE_FREE(entry);
189     }
190     mutex_unlock(&server->handoff_mutex);
191     mutex_destroy(&server->handoff_mutex);
192     server->handoff_mutex_initialized = false;

197     rate_limiter_destroy(server->rate_limiter);
